title: 原封不動
mood: giddy, sly, in on the joke
subject: an office secret-santa exchange on the last Friday before Christmas where, gift by gift, it emerges that everyone has quietly regifted last year's present, still in its wrapping
caption: Mandarin French touch filter house, late-90s Parisian filter disco revived in the Justice Hyperdrama era. A looped disco string-and-horn chord sample under a sweeping low-pass filter, a punchy four-on-the-floor kick with open hi-hats, a rubbery slap-style electric bass line, phaser-swept synth stabs, off-beat hand claps. Glossy, sidechain-pumping club mix where the filter opens fully on each chorus. Smooth female alto, conversational and dry, trading lines with a small office group chorus. 124 BPM, F minor. Giddy, sly and in on the joke. No hand drums or congas, no marimba, no log drums, no big-room EDM drop, no trap hi-hats, no autotune.
lyrics:
[Intro - filtered disco chord loop, kick and claps, filter slowly opens]

[Verse 1]
十二月最後一個星期五
會議室的燈 關了一半
我抽到七號 拿到一盒
包裝紙上 還貼著去年的名牌

[Pre-Chorus]
這個香氛蠟燭 怎麼好眼熟
去年我送出去的 就是它

[Chorus - filter fully open, slap bass]
原封不動 原封不動
繞了一圈 又回到我手中
大家笑著說謝謝 誰也不說破
原封不動 聖誕快樂

[Verse 2]
會計拆到圍巾 吊牌還在
經理拿到保溫杯 是他去年買的
實習生舉起卡片 念出聲來
給小陳 聖誕快樂 去年寫的

[Pre-Chorus]
小陳低下頭 喝了一口水
整個會議室 突然好安靜

[Chorus - filter fully open, slap bass]
原封不動 原封不動
繞了一圈 又回到原來那裡
大家笑著說謝謝 誰也不說破
原封不動 明年再見

[Outro - filter closes on the disco loop, kick and claps, group chants]
明年再見 明年再見
